author_text: Clement of Rome (by tradition; the letter itself speaks for the church at Rome)
context: Written from the church at Rome to the church at Corinth after younger members there deposed the presbyters; uses the phoenix as an image of the resurrection
themes: Church order | Humility | Repentance | Peace | Resurrection
pd_translation: J. B. Lightfoot (1891) | Roberts and Donaldson, Ante-Nicene Fathers vol. 1 (1885)
